added 4 commits
  • b55a6858...acbc327f - 3 commits from branch wireshark:master
  • 821dc0e1 - Fix SMB1 SMB_COM_SESSION_SETUP_ANDX (0x73) parsing failure.
[Compare with previous version](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/10992/diffs?diff_id=705089970&start_sha=b55a6858c5b06ad792f74f01afde990327858405)
mentioned in issue #19132

That does not seem correct if the 2 bytes long needle is in second and third position for example (so starting at abs_offet = 1).
Or are you doing this on purpose? If yes, the function name is confusing as one might assume it is name _generic simply because of the encoding parameter addition
The earlier logic looks for \x00\x00 at any location and new PR fixes it.

changed this line in [version 3 of the diff](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/10992/diffs?diff_id=705128551&start_sha=821dc0e176982a2a62ec1edb8f6a37882d1cf1c9#d18663b846f8bf4796bd6ed81715f849fbbaec35_2330_2306)
So I really think this should not be done by a tvbuff.c function named `tvb_find_guint16_generic` as this requirement is not generic but specific to SMB.
Sure. I moved it to the SMB dissector now.

So what is the current issue? The fact that the 2bytes long needled is not aligned on a two bytes boundary? If yes then maybe this should be handled by a helper located in the SMB dissector rather than in tvbuff.c

Yes you are right. It has to match the unicode null byte in 2 byte boundary.

![image](/uploads/3e2ce6983a31637d17c02265f23e7b44/image.png)

Sure. I will move it to SMB dissector.

changed this line in [version 3 of the diff](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/10992/diffs?diff_id=705128551&start_sha=821dc0e176982a2a62ec1edb8f6a37882d1cf1c9#425a024822dab1e64cad8d5571b6ccb0d2e0fc1b_1742_1770)
So what is the meaning of _generic in this context?

changed this line in [version 3 of the diff](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/10992/diffs?diff_id=705128551&start_sha=821dc0e176982a2a62ec1edb8f6a37882d1cf1c9#beff67078bc08961174b41dbd8c44fbe567577c6_527_527)

Your commit message should reference the #19132 issue you created (and that I discovered afterwards). Something like:
```
SMB1: fix SMB_COM_SESSION_SETUP_ANDX (0x73) parsing failure

Fixes #19132 
```
Could you please stash both changes in a single commit with the suggested commit message? Once done we can merge it.
Fixed it
